note: Public sample. Gold answers included deliberately. The evaluation split is private.

questions.question: How many relationship managers are currently active at the firm?
questions.domain_evidence: At this firm, 'relationship managers' refers to client-facing advisory staff in both the 'RM' and 'Junior RM' role categories. Senior titles such as MD, VP, and AVP are recorded as designations, not as a separate role_category.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_rm_count FROM advisor_profile WHERE is_active = TRUE AND role_category IN ('RM', 'Junior RM');

questions.question: How many unique client households with active clients exist in the system?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT household_code) AS total_households FROM investor_profile WHERE is_active = TRUE;

questions.question: Which business unit desk handles OCI clients?
questions.domain_evidence: OCI stands for Overseas Citizen of India, a residency classification used for clients.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sub_line_name FROM org_business_unit WHERE sub_line_code = 'OCI_DESK';

questions.question: What is the minimum investment required to invest in an active AIF product?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MIN(min_investment) AS min_aif_investment FROM instrument_master WHERE product_family = 'AIF' AND is_active = TRUE;

questions.question: List all seniority bands used in the advisor hierarchy.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT seniority_band FROM advisor_profile ORDER BY seniority_band;

questions.question: How many clients were onboarded in FY2023?
questions.domain_evidence: In India, a financial year runs from April 1 to March 31. FY2023 covers April 1, 2023 to March 31, 2024.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clients_onboarded_fy2023 FROM investor_profile WHERE onboarding_date BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2024-03-31';

questions.question: How many goals of type Legacy have been created for Family Office clients?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS legacy_goal_count FROM investor_goal g JOIN investor_profile i ON g.investor_sk = i.investor_sk WHERE g.goal_category = 'Legacy' AND i.client_segment = 'Family Office';

questions.question: How many clients in total, whether or not they are still active, have an expired KYC status?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS expired_kyc_count FROM investor_profile WHERE kyc_status = 'Expired';

questions.question: What is the LTCG tax rate and the exemption amount applicable to equity sold by a resident investor after July 23, 2024?
questions.domain_evidence: The Union Budget 2024 revised the long-term capital gains regime for equity with effect from July 23 2024. Rates and exemption limits are held in rule_taxation, versioned by effective_from and differentiated by asset class and residency status.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ltcg_tax_rate_pct, ltcg_exemption_inr FROM rule_taxation WHERE asset_class_code = 'EQ' AND residency_status = 'Resident' AND effective_from = '2024-07-23';

questions.question: How many active investors are classified as NRI?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nri_investor_count FROM investor_profile WHERE residency_status = 'NRI' AND is_active = TRUE;

questions.question: List the top 10 advisors by number of active clients assigned to them — showing each advisor's code, name, and seniority band; where advisors are tied on active-client count, rank them by advisor code in ascending order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name, a.seniority_band, COUNT(i.investor_sk) AS active_client_count FROM advisor_profile a JOIN investor_profile i ON a.advisor_sk = i.primary_advisor_sk WHERE i.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name, a.seniority_band ORDER BY active_client_count DESC, a.advisor_code ASC LIMIT 10;

questions.question: What is the total number of active investment accounts held by HNI segment clients?
questions.domain_evidence: Investment accounts include Demat, MF Folio, PMS, and AIF account types.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(a.account_sk) AS hni_investment_accounts FROM investor_account a JOIN investor_profile i ON a.investor_sk = i.investor_sk WHERE i.client_segment = 'HNI' AND a.account_type IN ('Demat', 'MF Folio', 'PMS', 'AIF') AND a.is_active = TRUE;

questions.question: Which instruments have a current credit rating of AAA from CRISIL? Show each instrument's name and product family, and the date it was rated.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT m.security_name, m.product_family, r.rated_on FROM instrument_credit_rating r JOIN instrument_master m ON r.instrument_sk = m.instrument_sk WHERE r.rating_agency = 'CRISIL' AND r.rating_value = 'AAA' AND r.is_current = TRUE ORDER BY m.security_name;

questions.question: List 50 clients — with each client's segment — who have at least one retirement goal with a target amount exceeding Rs 1 crore.
questions.domain_evidence: 1 crore = 10,000,000 in raw INR. Clients are identified by investor_code together with legal_name. Include these identifier columns in the result. Return the first 50 matching clients by investor_code ascending.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT i.investor_code, i.legal_name, i.client_segment FROM investor_profile i JOIN investor_goal g ON i.investor_sk = g.investor_sk WHERE g.goal_category = 'Retirement' AND g.target_amount > 10000000 ORDER BY i.investor_code ASC LIMIT 50;

questions.question: For each region, how many active advisors are there and what is their average revenue share percentage?
questions.domain_evidence: Round computed monetary and percentage values to 2 decimal places.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS advisor_count, ROUND(AVG(revenue_share_pct), 2) AS avg_rev_share_pct FROM advisor_profile WHERE is_active = TRUE GROUP BY region ORDER BY advisor_count DESC;

questions.question: How many active clients have an AUM above the HNI threshold of Rs 50 lakhs?
questions.domain_evidence: 50 lakhs = 5,000,000 in raw INR.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clients_above_hni_threshold FROM investor_profile WHERE aum_inr > 5000000 AND is_active = TRUE;

questions.question: How many new clients were acquired in FY2024?
questions.domain_evidence: FY2024 in India runs from April 1 2024 to March 31 2025.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_clients_fy2024 FROM investor_profile WHERE onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31';

questions.question: What is the total brokerage charged on equity sell trades in Q1 FY2025?
questions.domain_evidence: Q1 FY2025 in India covers April 1 2025 to June 30 2025. Round computed monetary and percentage values to 2 decimal places.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.brokerage), 2) AS total_brokerage FROM txn_trade t JOIN instrument_master m ON t.instrument_sk = m.instrument_sk WHERE t.trade_action = 'Sell' AND m.product_family = 'Direct Equity' AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30';

questions.question: Which advisors missed their new client acquisition target in FY2024?
questions.domain_evidence: FY2024 runs from April 1 2024 to March 31 2025. This window is also recorded in kpi_advisor_target as period_start_date and period_end_date for target_period = 'FY2024'. Advisors are identified by advisor_code together with advisor_full_name. Include these identifier columns in the result.
questions.gold_sql: WITH fy_window AS (SELECT DISTINCT period_start_date, period_end_date FROM kpi_advisor_target WHERE target_period = 'FY2024'), actual_new_clients AS (SELECT i.primary_advisor_sk, COUNT(*) AS actual_count FROM investor_profile i, fy_window w WHERE i.onboarding_date BETWEEN w.period_start_date AND w.period_end_date GROUP BY i.primary_advisor_sk), targets AS (SELECT advisor_sk, target_new_clients FROM kpi_advisor_target WHERE target_period = 'FY2024' AND target_new_clients IS NOT NULL) SELECT a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name, t.target_new_clients FROM targets t JOIN advisor_profile a ON t.advisor_sk = a.advisor_sk LEFT JOIN actual_new_clients anc ON t.advisor_sk = anc.primary_advisor_sk WHERE t.target_new_clients > COALESCE(anc.actual_count, 0) ORDER BY t.target_new_clients - COALESCE(anc.actual_count, 0) DESC;

questions.question: List advisors whose FY2025 gross revenue achieved at least 50% of their FY2025 KPI revenue target (in crore).
questions.domain_evidence: FY2025 runs April 1 2025 to March 31 2026. target_revenue_inr in kpi_advisor_target is the firm gross revenue target. gross_revenue_inr in txn_firm_revenue is the realized firm revenue. Advisors are identified by advisor_code together with advisor_full_name. Include these identifier columns in the result. Round computed monetary and percentage values to 4 decimal places.
questions.gold_sql: WITH actual_revenue AS (SELECT primary_advisor_sk, SUM(gross_revenue_inr) AS total_revenue FROM txn_firm_revenue WHERE revenue_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31' GROUP BY primary_advisor_sk), targets AS (SELECT advisor_sk, target_revenue_inr FROM kpi_advisor_target WHERE target_period = 'FY2025') SELECT a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name, ROUND(ar.total_revenue / 10000000, 4) AS actual_revenue_crore, ROUND(t.target_revenue_inr / 10000000, 4) AS target_revenue_crore FROM actual_revenue ar JOIN targets t ON ar.primary_advisor_sk = t.advisor_sk JOIN advisor_profile a ON ar.primary_advisor_sk = a.advisor_sk WHERE ar.total_revenue >= 0.5 * t.target_revenue_inr ORDER BY ROUND(ar.total_revenue / t.target_revenue_inr, 4) DESC, a.advisor_code ASC;

questions.question: Show the full management chain from every advisor up to the Managing Director.
questions.domain_evidence: Advisors are identified by advisor_code together with advisor_full_name. Include these identifier columns in the result. Report the chain as a single text value listing advisor full names from the Managing Director down to the advisor, separated by ' > ' (space, greater-than, space). An advisor with no line manager has a chain consisting of their own name alone.
questions.gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE mgmt_chain AS (SELECT advisor_sk, advisor_code, advisor_full_name, designation, line_manager_advisor_sk, 1 AS depth, CAST(advisor_full_name AS TEXT) AS chain FROM advisor_profile WHERE line_manager_advisor_sk IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.advisor_sk, a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name, a.designation, a.line_manager_advisor_sk, mc.depth + 1, mc.chain || ' > ' || a.advisor_full_name FROM advisor_profile a JOIN mgmt_chain mc ON a.line_manager_advisor_sk = mc.advisor_sk) SELECT advisor_code, advisor_full_name, chain FROM mgmt_chain ORDER BY depth, advisor_code;

questions.question: Rank all advisors by their total number of active clients. Show each advisor's active client count and their percentile rank, expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100 where the advisor with the most clients ranks highest.
questions.domain_evidence: Advisors are identified by advisor_code together with advisor_full_name. Include these identifier columns in the result. Round computed monetary and percentage values to 2 decimal places.
questions.gold_sql: WITH advisor_clients AS (SELECT a.advisor_sk, a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name, COUNT(i.investor_sk) AS client_count FROM advisor_profile a LEFT JOIN investor_profile i ON a.advisor_sk = i.primary_advisor_sk AND i.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY a.advisor_sk, a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name) SELECT advisor_code, advisor_full_name, client_count, ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY client_count) * 100, 2) AS percentile FROM advisor_clients ORDER BY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY client_count DESC);

questions.question: For each calendar month in 2024, show the total trade count, the previous month's trade count, the absolute month-over-month change, and the percentage change.
questions.domain_evidence: Round computed monetary and percentage values to 2 decimal places.
questions.gold_sql: WITH monthly_trades AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', trade_date) AS year_month, COUNT(*) AS trade_count FROM txn_trade WHERE trade_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', trade_date)) SELECT year_month, trade_count, LAG(trade_count) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_count, trade_count - LAG(trade_count) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS mom_change, ROUND(100.0 * (trade_count - LAG(trade_count) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) / NULLIF(LAG(trade_count) OVER (ORDER BY year_month), 0), 2) AS mom_pct_change FROM monthly_trades ORDER BY year_month;

questions.question: For each business unit desk, show the top-performing advisor by total revenue generated in FY2025 using a window function (in crore).
questions.domain_evidence: FY2025 runs April 1 2025 to March 31 2026. Advisors are identified by advisor_code together with advisor_full_name. Include these identifier columns in the result. Round computed monetary and percentage values to 4 decimal places. Revenue means the firm's gross revenue, stored as gross_revenue_inr in txn_firm_revenue — not net revenue, the advisor's commission, or the firm-retained portion.
questions.gold_sql: WITH advisor_rev AS (SELECT r.primary_advisor_sk, SUM(r.gross_revenue_inr) AS total_revenue FROM txn_firm_revenue r WHERE r.revenue_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY r.primary_advisor_sk), ranked AS (SELECT a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name, a.business_unit_sk, ar.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.business_unit_sk ORDER BY ar.total_revenue DESC) AS desk_rank FROM advisor_rev ar JOIN advisor_profile a ON ar.primary_advisor_sk = a.advisor_sk) SELECT o.sub_line_name AS desk, r.advisor_code, r.advisor_full_name, ROUND(r.total_revenue / 10000000, 4) AS revenue_crore FROM ranked r JOIN org_business_unit o ON r.business_unit_sk = o.business_unit_sk WHERE r.desk_rank = 1 ORDER BY revenue_crore DESC;

questions.question: For clients who have both at least one account and at least one trade, show me the 50 with the longest gap between their first account opening and their first trade — the first account date, the first trade date, and the number of days between those two events.
questions.domain_evidence: Use DATE_DIFF('day', start_date, end_date) to compute day differences between two DATE values. Clients are identified by investor_code together with legal_name. Include these identifier columns in the result. Ties on the number of days are broken by investor_code ascending.
questions.gold_sql: WITH first_account AS (SELECT investor_sk, MIN(opened_on) AS first_account_date FROM investor_account GROUP BY investor_sk), first_trade AS (SELECT investor_sk, MIN(trade_date) AS first_trade_date FROM txn_trade GROUP BY investor_sk) SELECT i.investor_code, i.legal_name, fa.first_account_date, ft.first_trade_date, DATE_DIFF('day', fa.first_account_date, ft.first_trade_date) AS days_to_first_trade FROM investor_profile i JOIN first_account fa ON i.investor_sk = fa.investor_sk JOIN first_trade ft ON i.investor_sk = ft.investor_sk ORDER BY days_to_first_trade DESC, i.investor_code ASC LIMIT 50;

questions.question: Calculate each resident investor's total LTCG tax liability on equity sold on or after July 23 2024, applying the Budget 2024 rate of 12.5% on gains above Rs 1.25 lakh exemption, and show me the 50 investors with the highest liability.
questions.domain_evidence: Budget 2024 effective July 23 2024: LTCG rate on equity raised to 12.5% with exemption limit raised to Rs 1.25 lakh (125000). LTCG requires holding period >= 365 days. Resident investors only. Clients are identified by investor_code together with legal_name. Include these identifier columns in the result. Round computed monetary and percentage values to 2 decimal places. Ties on tax liability are broken by investor_code ascending.
questions.gold_sql: WITH ltcg_gains AS (SELECT cl.investor_sk, SUM((cl.matched_sell_unit_price - cl.matched_buy_unit_cost) * cl.matched_quantity) AS total_gain FROM txn_lot_closure cl JOIN instrument_master m ON cl.instrument_sk = m.instrument_sk WHERE cl.sold_on >= '2024-07-23' AND cl.holding_period_days >= 365 AND m.asset_class_code = 'EQ' GROUP BY cl.investor_sk), tax_calc AS (SELECT lg.investor_sk, lg.total_gain, GREATEST(0, lg.total_gain - 125000) AS taxable_gain, GREATEST(0, lg.total_gain - 125000) * 0.125 AS ltcg_tax FROM ltcg_gains lg JOIN investor_profile i ON lg.investor_sk = i.investor_sk WHERE i.residency_status = 'Resident') SELECT i.investor_code, i.legal_name, ROUND(tc.total_gain, 2) AS total_ltcg_gain, ROUND(tc.ltcg_tax, 2) AS ltcg_tax_liability FROM tax_calc tc JOIN investor_profile i ON tc.investor_sk = i.investor_sk WHERE tc.total_gain > 0 ORDER BY tc.ltcg_tax DESC, i.investor_code ASC LIMIT 50;

questions.question: Identify the top 5 most profitable equity sell transactions in 2025 by absolute profit, showing the per-unit buy lot cost and the per-unit sell price.
questions.domain_evidence: Profit per closure = (matched_sell_unit_price - matched_buy_unit_cost) * matched_quantity. 'Equity' here means asset_class_code = 'EQ' (includes equity mutual funds and index products, not only product_family = 'Direct Equity'). Clients are identified by investor_code. Include these identifier columns in the result. Round the per-unit buy cost and sell price to 4 decimal places, and the absolute profit to 2 decimal places.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT i.investor_code, m.security_name, cl.matched_quantity, ROUND(cl.matched_buy_unit_cost, 4) AS buy_cost_per_unit, ROUND(cl.matched_sell_unit_price, 4) AS sell_price_per_unit, ROUND((cl.matched_sell_unit_price - cl.matched_buy_unit_cost) * cl.matched_quantity, 2) AS absolute_profit FROM txn_lot_closure cl JOIN instrument_master m ON cl.instrument_sk = m.instrument_sk JOIN investor_profile i ON cl.investor_sk = i.investor_sk WHERE cl.sold_on BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND m.asset_class_code = 'EQ' ORDER BY absolute_profit DESC, cl.closure_sk ASC LIMIT 5;

questions.question: Calculate the total STCG on equity sold between April 1 2024 and July 22 2024 applying the pre-Budget 2024 rate of 15%.
questions.domain_evidence: Pre-Budget 2024 STCG rate on equity was 15%. STCG requires holding_period_days < 365. The date range must be strictly before July 23 2024. 'Equity' means asset_class_code = 'EQ' (includes equity mutual funds and index products, not only product_family = 'Direct Equity'). Round computed monetary and percentage values to 2 decimal places.
questions.gold_sql: WITH stcg_calc AS (SELECT cl.investor_sk, SUM((cl.matched_sell_unit_price - cl.matched_buy_unit_cost) * cl.matched_quantity) AS total_stcg_gain FROM txn_lot_closure cl JOIN instrument_master m ON cl.instrument_sk = m.instrument_sk WHERE cl.sold_on BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-07-22' AND cl.holding_period_days < 365 AND m.asset_class_code = 'EQ' GROUP BY cl.investor_sk) SELECT ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(stcg_calc.total_stcg_gain, 0)) * 0.15, 2) AS total_stcg_tax_pre_budget FROM stcg_calc;

questions.question: Which 50 clients have the largest unrealized losses on their open equity positions as of the latest available price date — showing each client's segment and unrealized loss (in crore)?
questions.domain_evidence: Unrealized PnL = (current_market_value - cost_basis). Unrealized loss means current market value is below cost basis. Open positions (a client's current holdings) = lots in pos_holding_lot with lot_status 'Open' or 'Partially Closed'; fully closed lots (lot_status = 'Closed', zero remaining quantity) are excluded. Clients are identified by investor_code together with legal_name. Include these identifier columns in the result. Round computed monetary and percentage values to 4 decimal places. Ties on the unrealized loss are broken by investor_code ascending.
questions.gold_sql: WITH latest_prices AS (SELECT instrument_sk, close_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY instrument_sk ORDER BY price_date DESC) AS rn FROM market_price_daily), open_positions AS (SELECT l.investor_sk, l.instrument_sk, SUM(l.remaining_quantity) AS total_qty, SUM(l.remaining_quantity * l.acquired_unit_cost) AS total_cost FROM pos_holding_lot l WHERE l.lot_status IN ('Open', 'Partially Closed') GROUP BY l.investor_sk, l.instrument_sk), position_pnl AS (SELECT op.investor_sk, op.instrument_sk, op.total_qty, op.total_cost, op.total_qty * lp.close_price AS current_value, (op.total_qty * lp.close_price) - op.total_cost AS unrealized_pnl FROM open_positions op JOIN latest_prices lp ON op.instrument_sk = lp.instrument_sk AND lp.rn = 1), investor_pnl AS (SELECT pp.investor_sk, SUM(pp.unrealized_pnl) AS total_unrealized_pnl FROM position_pnl pp JOIN instrument_master m ON pp.instrument_sk = m.instrument_sk WHERE m.asset_class_code = 'EQ' GROUP BY pp.investor_sk) SELECT i.investor_code, i.legal_name, i.client_segment, ROUND(ip.total_unrealized_pnl / 10000000, 4) AS unrealized_loss_crore FROM investor_pnl ip JOIN investor_profile i ON ip.investor_sk = i.investor_sk WHERE ip.total_unrealized_pnl < 0 ORDER BY ip.total_unrealized_pnl ASC, i.investor_code ASC LIMIT 50;

questions.question: Calculate the revenue attainment rate for each advisor in FY2025 — actual gross revenue as a percentage of their FY2025 revenue target — showing each advisor's seniority band, their actual and target revenue (in crore), and the attainment percentage.
questions.domain_evidence: FY2025 runs April 1 2025 to March 31 2026. Attainment = actual / target * 100. Advisors are identified by advisor_code together with advisor_full_name. Include these identifier columns in the result. Round the actual and target revenue (in crore) to 4 decimal places, and the attainment percentage to 2 decimal places.
questions.gold_sql: WITH actual AS (SELECT primary_advisor_sk, SUM(gross_revenue_inr) AS actual_rev FROM txn_firm_revenue WHERE revenue_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY primary_advisor_sk) SELECT a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name, a.seniority_band, ROUND(COALESCE(ac.actual_rev, 0) / 10000000, 4) AS actual_rev_crore, ROUND(k.target_revenue_inr / 10000000, 4) AS target_rev_crore, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(ac.actual_rev, 0) / NULLIF(k.target_revenue_inr, 0), 2) AS attainment_pct FROM kpi_advisor_target k JOIN advisor_profile a ON k.advisor_sk = a.advisor_sk LEFT JOIN actual ac ON k.advisor_sk = ac.primary_advisor_sk WHERE k.target_period = 'FY2025' ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC;

questions.question: List all clients who have a Rejected KYC status and also have an active investment account, showing the account type.
questions.domain_evidence: Clients are identified by investor_code together with legal_name. Include these identifier columns in the result.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT i.investor_code, i.legal_name, a.account_type FROM investor_profile i JOIN investor_account a ON i.investor_sk = a.investor_sk WHERE i.kyc_status = 'Rejected' AND a.is_active = TRUE;

questions.question: List any advisor who has more than 500 active clients assigned to them.
questions.domain_evidence: Advisors are identified by advisor_code together with advisor_full_name. Include these identifier columns in the result.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM investor_profile ip JOIN advisor_profile a ON a.advisor_sk = ip.primary_advisor_sk WHERE ip.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY a.advisor_code, a.advisor_full_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 500;

questions.question: Find any clients who have a goal target date in the past before June 10 2026 but the goal is still marked as active.
questions.domain_evidence: Clients are identified by investor_code. Include these identifier columns in the result.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT i.investor_code, g.target_date, g.target_amount FROM investor_goal g JOIN investor_profile i ON g.investor_sk = i.investor_sk WHERE g.target_date < '2026-06-10' AND g.is_active = TRUE;

questions.question: Show all trade records where the settlement date is earlier than the trade date.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT trade_reference, trade_date, settlement_date FROM txn_trade WHERE settlement_date < trade_date;

questions.question: Are there any instruments that have both a current credit rating of AAA and a current credit rating of D from the same or different agencies?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT m.security_name FROM instrument_master m WHERE m.instrument_sk IN (SELECT instrument_sk FROM instrument_credit_rating WHERE rating_value = 'AAA' AND is_current = TRUE INTERSECT SELECT instrument_sk FROM instrument_credit_rating WHERE rating_value = 'D' AND is_current = TRUE) ORDER BY m.security_name;

questions.question: How many clients were onboarded in each quarter of FY2024?
questions.domain_evidence: FY2024 runs April 1 2024 to March 31 2025. Indian fiscal quarters: Q1=Apr-Jun 2024, Q2=Jul-Sep 2024, Q3=Oct-Dec 2024, Q4=Jan-Mar 2025.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-06-30' THEN 'Q1 FY2024' WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-09-30' THEN 'Q2 FY2024' WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN 'Q3 FY2024' WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' THEN 'Q4 FY2024' END AS fiscal_quarter, COUNT(*) AS clients_onboarded FROM investor_profile WHERE onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31' GROUP BY fiscal_quarter ORDER BY fiscal_quarter;

questions.question: Which quarter had the highest onboarding count and what referral sources drove it?
questions.domain_evidence: Coreference: which quarter = highest count quarter from Turn 1.
questions.gold_sql: WITH best_quarter AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-06-30' THEN 'Q1 FY2024' WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-09-30' THEN 'Q2 FY2024' WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN 'Q3 FY2024' WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' THEN 'Q4 FY2024' END AS fiscal_quarter, MIN(onboarding_date) AS q_start, MAX(onboarding_date) AS q_end, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM investor_profile WHERE onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31' GROUP BY fiscal_quarter ORDER BY cnt DESC, fiscal_quarter ASC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT referral_source, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM investor_profile WHERE onboarding_date BETWEEN (SELECT q_start FROM best_quarter) AND (SELECT q_end FROM best_quarter) GROUP BY referral_source ORDER BY client_count DESC;

questions.question: Of the clients onboarded in that best quarter, how many placed their first trade within 90 days of onboarding?
questions.domain_evidence: Coreference: that best quarter = highest onboarding quarter from Turn 1. First trade within 90 days means MIN(trade_date) <= onboarding_date + 90 days.
questions.gold_sql: WITH best_quarter AS ( SELECT MIN(onboarding_date) AS q_start, MAX(onboarding_date) AS q_end FROM investor_profile WHERE onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-06-30' THEN 'Q1' WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-09-30' THEN 'Q2' WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(onboarding_date) ASC LIMIT 1 ), cohort AS ( SELECT investor_sk, onboarding_date FROM investor_profile WHERE onboarding_date BETWEEN (SELECT q_start FROM best_quarter) AND (SELECT q_end FROM best_quarter) ), first_trades AS ( SELECT t.investor_sk, MIN(t.trade_date) AS first_trade_date FROM txn_trade t WHERE t.investor_sk IN (SELECT investor_sk FROM cohort) GROUP BY t.investor_sk ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS traded_within_90_days FROM first_trades ft JOIN cohort c ON ft.investor_sk = c.investor_sk WHERE DATE_DIFF('day', c.onboarding_date, ft.first_trade_date) <= 90;

questions.question: What is the current average AUM (in crore) of those quick-to-trade clients versus those from the same quarter who took longer than 90 days to place their first trade, counting only clients still active?
questions.domain_evidence: Coreference: quick-to-trade = first trade within 90 days from Turn 3. Same quarter cohort = best quarter from Turn 1. Compares two sub-groups of the same cohort. Round computed monetary and percentage values to 4 decimal places.
questions.gold_sql: WITH best_quarter AS ( SELECT MIN(onboarding_date) AS q_start, MAX(onboarding_date) AS q_end FROM investor_profile WHERE onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2024-06-30' THEN 'Q1' WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-09-30' THEN 'Q2' WHEN onboarding_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MIN(onboarding_date) ASC LIMIT 1 ), cohort AS ( SELECT i.investor_sk, i.onboarding_date, i.aum_inr FROM investor_profile i WHERE i.onboarding_date BETWEEN (SELECT q_start FROM best_quarter) AND (SELECT q_end FROM best_quarter) AND i.is_active = TRUE ), first_trades AS ( SELECT t.investor_sk, MIN(t.trade_date) AS first_trade_date FROM txn_trade t WHERE t.investor_sk IN (SELECT investor_sk FROM cohort) GROUP BY t.investor_sk ), classified AS ( SELECT c.investor_sk, c.aum_inr, CASE WHEN ft.first_trade_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE_DIFF('day', c.onboarding_date, ft.first_trade_date) <= 90 THEN 'Quick (<=90 days)' ELSE 'Slow (>90 days or no trade)' END AS trader_type FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN first_trades ft ON c.investor_sk = ft.investor_sk ) SELECT trader_type, ROUND(AVG(aum_inr) / 10000000, 4) AS avg_aum_crore FROM classified GROUP BY trader_type ORDER BY avg_aum_crore DESC;
